title: Verify global search still returns results for Technician after the empty-results change
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role.
Customers and work orders exist that match the search term.
Context: a build change makes global search return EMPTY results for the Time Clock role - confirm Technician is not also affected.
steps:
1. Click the top search bar.
2. Type the name of an existing customer and press Enter.
3. Type the number of an existing work order and press Enter.
expected: Global search returns the matching customer and work order for Technician (results are NOT empty). Only the Time Clock role should return empty search results.
